facts.doc_claim: each identity runs its own BCCM batch push against its own application scope (spec/operations/multi-identity-operation-twill-personas.md §35.4)
facts.code_truth: PersonaRuntimeDeps.runBccmPush is supplied by bootstrap and invoked per persona start; it runs runBccmBatchPush against the persona's own applicationId, so the main bot's push (which ignores the persona scope) never carries her queued cosmetics
facts.resolution: Documented in v5.5.101 (spec §35.4); previously a landed behaviour with no documentation and no reconciliation row (UR-20261018-092 DR-2). Confirmed live 2026-10-18: the persona-side push ran on Railway (bccm-batch-push-complete dryRun=false).

facts.doc_claim: hash-bound provenance verification against the build record is the enforced floor, and the promoted artifact is verified before import (spec/governance/part-4-module-system-framework.md rule D-4.10; spec/modules/swastik-hot-reload-dynamic-module-management.md §15.8/§15.9)
facts.code_truth: the loader requires a build-provenance sidecar (no sidecar -> refuse), verifies the on-disk artifact hash against the builds row (L1, always), refuses a revoked build, and verifies the Ed25519 signature (L2, mandatory — no armed verifier -> refuse); bootstrap supplies the build store unconditionally and arms the verifier from BUILD_SIGNING_*
facts.resolution: Resolved by UR-20261019-101/103 (re-verified at HEAD 3afcc494cc53f8a022ccaaf1cbe5de051838bc96): the D-4.10 hash-bound floor always runs when a build store is supplied, and the signature layer is mandatory — the loader no longer imports an unverified module. Previously recorded as a code-gap (fail-open); the floor now holds.

facts.area: module delivery — Option A (image ships no modules)
facts.doc_claim: first-party modules are delivered to their tier volumes and are not baked into the application image (spec/modules/swastik-hot-reload-dynamic-module-management.md; orchestration/master-prompt.md Phase 6: 'first-party modules are seeded onto their tier volumes … they are not committed into the source tree')
facts.code_truth: the production image ships no modules; apps/main/scripts/build-modules.ts and push-modules.ts deliver them to the MODULES_DIR tier volumes; the seed/place/stage scripts are removed (UR-20261019-102 Option A)
facts.resolution: Re-verified against HEAD 3afcc494cc53f8a022ccaaf1cbe5de051838bc96 — the image carries no modules; delivery is build:modules -> push:modules to the tier volumes.

facts.area: module load — signature layer is mandatory
facts.doc_claim: the runtime verifies a promoted module's provenance before import (spec/modules/swastik-hot-reload-dynamic-module-management.md §15.8/§15.9)
facts.code_truth: the loader refuses a module with no build-provenance sidecar, refuses a build with no builds row or a missing provenance column, refuses a hash mismatch, refuses a revoked build, and refuses when no signing verifier is armed (L2 mandatory); bootstrap arms the verifier from BUILD_SIGNING_KEY_ID + BUILD_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY/PRIVATE_KEY (UR-20261019-103)
facts.resolution: Re-verified against HEAD 3afcc494cc53f8a022ccaaf1cbe5de051838bc96 — every load-time provenance control is mandatory.
